C-r2.display_read_from: what it announces (a segmented display with no text)

notes.b1/j1/C-r1: Clean dark calculator with a 12-digit cap, shows the last expression, labelled keys, live region, good keyboard handling and a clear Error state; slightly small keys on desktop.
notes.b1/j1/R-r1: Charming retro LCD design, but the history panel and extra backspace bar overbuild a basic calculator, and the Escape handler contains odd leftover code.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Solid iOS-style calculator with repeat-equals and percent; equals styled identically to the operators, error message is just Error, and the 15-digit cap overflows the display.
notes.b1/j1/R-r2: Polished light calculator with strong hierarchy, thousands separators, repeat-equals, a readable 'Cannot divide by zero' message, labelled keys and screen-reader status; the display shrinks the 12-digit number to fit.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Compact and correct with a clear error message, but the operator keys have no aria labels and the display has no status role; the dark palette is fine but plain.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: A seven-segment pocket calculator with a distinctive look and a screen-reader live region; limited to 9 digits and larger results turn to Error, and the SVG display code adds weight.
notes.b1/j2/R-r2: Clean iOS-style calculator with expression line, grouped digits, clear zero message, aria-live and keyboard; complete and not overbuilt.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Tidy dark basic calculator with correct results and divide-by-zero message; plain look and small text on long numbers but solid.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Striking seven-segment pocket calculator with tactile keys and backspace; 8-digit cap and Error display are authentic, though the styling adds code weight.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Dark orange iOS-like calculator that works well; shows only 'Error' on divide by zero and the 0 key label sits left, slightly less polished.
notes.b1/j2/R-r1: Attractive retro LCD design, but the history panel and extra Backspace bar overbuild a basic calculator and add the most code.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: Polished dark blue-accent calculator with expression line, backspace, clear Error state and good phone layout; thin key labels slightly low contrast.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Clean dark iOS-style calculator, correct results, friendly divide-by-zero message, grouped long numbers; the dim operator keys are a little low in contrast and only two aria attributes.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Distinctive seven-segment LCD pocket calculator with tactile keys and a good phone layout; caps at 9 digits and the SVG digit code is longer, but the ERR state, 0.3 and clear all work.
notes.b1/j3/R-r2: Warm light iOS-like calculator with a good active-operator state and aria labels; correct, compact, and nothing extra.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: Dark panel with a clear blue equals key, a backspace key, a red Error state and a showing expression line; handles every test correctly, with strong accessibility and keyboard support.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Solid dark calculator with orange operators, but the 0 key's left-aligned label looks off and the long-number line is tiny.
notes.b1/j3/R-r1: Charming retro LCD design, but the history panel is padded scope for a basic calculator and pushes the layout off centre.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Warm, clear and complete with C, CE, backspace and an expression trail, but the pale-peach operators are a bit faint and C plus CE is slightly redundant.
notes.b2/j1/R-r3: Distinctive LCD-and-tactile-keys look with a wide zero, accessible and correct, though the skeuomorphic styling and separate Backspace bar add some extra weight.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Lean, tidy dark calculator that handles the cases well, but there is no backspace, the 'Cannot divide by 0' message is small and plain, and the operator keys are low contrast.
notes.b2/j1/R-r4: Polished iOS-style with strong key hierarchy and a red divide-by-zero message, a little overbuilt with 3D bevel and the Backspace bar.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Minimal and correct with a clear Error display, but the generic orange-and-grey look is plain, there is no backspace, and the '+/-' label is crude.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Cohesive light design with crisp display hierarchy, clear operator and equals colouring, a backspace icon and a helpful 'Cannot divide by zero' note, all in a compact basic layout.
notes.b2/j2/R-r4: Polished iOS-style dark calculator with repeat-equals, C/AC, aria labels and keyboard, though the red zero-error text and extra Backspace bar add a little bulk.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Clean and small with commas and a sensible layout, but it has almost no ARIA, the error is a bare 'Error', and there is no repeat-equals.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Calm light theme with good contrast, the active operator is highlighted, the backspace key is compact, the font fits to width, and it has full keyboard and ARIA support.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Smallest source and a handsome dark layout, but the clear key is always AC, ARIA is minimal, and the error replaces the display with plain text.
notes.b2/j2/R-r3: Distinctive LCD-and-hardware look with repeat-equals, percent-aware add/subtract, a clear error caption, and strong tactile keys; slightly more than basic.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: Friendly warm design with a useful C/CE split, thousands separators and a clear error caption; it has no percent key and a slightly odd '≠ a number' string in the source.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Compact and correct, but no backspace, a generic iOS-clone look, and a bare 'Error' on divide by zero.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Warm, distinctive palette with clear hierarchy, backspace, a 'Cannot divide by zero' note, solid keyboard and aria support.
notes.b2/j3/R-r4: Polished tactile iOS-style device with a clear error message and backspace, though the wide Backspace bar is a bit heavy.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Friendly light design with C, CE and backspace, flash feedback on keys, a descriptive error line and thorough keyboard support.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Small and tidy with a clear orange equals key, but the operator keys are low contrast and there is no backspace.
notes.b2/j3/R-r3: Distinctive LCD-and-keys look with a monospace readout, backspace and good feedback, but a bit more styled than basic.
